scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.build:client: npm run build --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:server: npm run build --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix server
